lines.en: Like clockwork, I wind up bumping into Yumi after just a few minutes of wandering the streets.
lines.zh: 像上了发条一样，我在街上晃了没几分钟就撞见了 Yumi。

lines.en: And while I’d like to say that I think it’s good that she isn’t intentionally trying to avoid me anymore, I can not. For the second she sees me approaching, she gets up to walk away.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想说，我觉得她不再刻意躲我这件事挺好的，但我说不出口。因为她一看见我靠近，就起身要走。

lines.en: Somehow or another, though, I wind up convincing her to stick around and the two of us proceed to make scattered pointless conversation that, to anyone else, would make it seem like we dislike each other.
lines.zh: 可不知怎么的，我还是说服她留了下来，我们俩开始东一句西一句地聊些毫无意义的废话——在旁人看来，我们大概像是互相讨厌。

lines.en: That’s wrong, though. And I don’t just mean from one angle.
lines.zh: 可这不对。而且不只是从一个角度来说不对。

lines.en: The truth is that even being able to talk to her without her running off is a monumental improvement from the way things used to be.
lines.zh: 真相是，光是能跟她说上话而她不跑掉，相比从前就已经是巨大的进步了。

lines.en: And while I’d prefer not to jinx myself by saying something like, “We might be on the precipice of some sort of breakthrough...”
lines.zh: 虽然我不想为了给自己招霉运而说出“我们也许正处在某种突破的边缘”这种话……

lines.en: I think that we might be on the precipice of some sort of breakthrough.
lines.zh: 但我觉得，我们确实可能正处在某种突破的边缘。

lines.en: Of course, that remains to be seen.
With the way Yumi is, she could start hating me again at any moment.
lines.zh: 以 Yumi 的性子，她随时可能又开始恨我。

lines.en: And, with the way I am-
I’m sure it would be the result of something I did.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，那一定会是我干的好事。
